Package io.telekom.orchest.enginecore.bpmn.execution

Interface NodeExecutor

All Known Implementing Classes:
BoundaryEventExecutor, BusinessRuleTaskExecutor, CallActivityExecutor, ConnectorDispatchExecutor, EmptyTaskExecutor, EndEventExecutor, EventBasedGatewayExecutor, ExclusiveGatewayExecutor, InclusiveGatewayExecutor, IntermediateCatchEventExecutor, IntermediateThrowEventExecutor, ManualTaskExecutor, ParallelGatewayExecutor, ReceiveTaskExecutor, ScriptTaskExecutor, SendTaskExecutor, ServiceTaskExecutor, StartEventExecutor, SubProcessExecutor, UserTaskExecutor
public interface NodeExecutor
Interface for executing BPMN nodes during process instance execution. Implementations handle the specific logic for different node types (e.g., tasks, gateways, events). Each node type has its own executor that implements this interface.
